data.name: Portal Knights
data.detailed_description:
CHECK OUT "THE BLOODLINE" FROM OUR FRIENDS AT HOOK!


Acerca do jogo



Prove yourself a Portal Knight by levelling up your character, crafting epic weapons, and vanquishing foes in real-time in this cooperative, 3D sandbox action RPG.

Explore dozens of randomly-generated islands! Build almost anything! In a world torn apart by the Fracture and terrorized by the Hollow King, you and your friends are its only hope!

Craft your adventure. Forge your hero. Become the ultimate Portal Knight!

Key Features


  • Play as a Warrior, Mage or Ranger, then customize your appearance, abilities, and gear. Unlock amazing new talents as you level up!



  • Build almost anything using dozens of materials and furnishings – including NPCs! Unlock private islands where you can build your own castle to store your treasured belongings and to show off to your friends!



  • Vanquish enemies in real-time tactical combat! Consider carefully a foe's unique strengths and weaknesses as you choose from a variety of weapons, spells, and special abilities!



  • Use the mysterious Portals to travel between dozens of randomly generated 3D sandbox worlds. Collect resources for crafting in caves, lakes, and dungeons filled with surprises.



  • Play with friends in 4-person cooperative multiplayer or on a 2-player split screen. Work together to build awe-inspiring architecture and explore dangerous dungeons or play separately.


  • Architect your own island! Create AMAZING structures quickly and easily in Creative Mode and share them with your friends on the Steam Workshop!



  • Vanquish the Greatbeasts – the most vicious and dangerous "boss" creatures in all the realm. Each has their own hideous hideaway.



  • Explore a world filled with colorful characters, aid them in their quests, and bring them to your castle!



  • Take the adventure to ever-changing landscapes as you complete quests and earn exclusive items during random events across the fractured world.

reviews.review:
A very underrated Sandbox RPG game.

I actually remember playing it in 2016. I don't know which version I played, but there wasn't much to do, it was still fun, but that's it, so I never really came back to it, but then we started playing it with a friend, just looking for a chill and colorful game, and I said we could play Portal Knights. I said that without knowing what the game became, and damn, I'm writing that, just after getting my last achievement, and I actually had A LOT OF FUN.

It is a pretty classic Sandbox RPG, roam around, collect things, craft stuff, get spells, and fight enemies or bosses, and repeat. You get a lot of islands to explore and NPCs with side quests, and with the story basically just being a "hey, the very bad and evil thing is back, go fight it", you just enjoy the game without thinking much about what you do, and that feels great, it works very well.

You create your little character and choose from 3 classes, 5 if you get both of the DLCs, they're very different, all of them coming with 3 main weapon types plus different special other types that you'll be able to obtain through your journey. I played all of them and leveled up to max level. Even if I think that some of them are stronger than the other, I managed to complete the game without too much difficulty with each of them, and I had fun every single time.

The DLCs are great, nothing much to add. I just took them as special mini-games that came with the two classes.

The game wasn't actually easy in terms of gameplay, I think it's quite fun and challenging. If you're not prepared enough, enemies can deal a lot of damage if you don't try to learn what they can do and don't use your dodges well enough. It's a perfect middle between a casual game and challenging gameplay with an endgame where you can break your build and become invincible or deal a lot of damage. Talking about that, I wasn't expecting Portal Knights to give us such an interesting endgame, between dungeons and "super bosses", I had a lot of fun trying to see what I could do to make this experience easier, which class to use, which equipment or element...

I heavily recommend this game if you're just looking for a chill experience. There are a lot of YouTube videos if you're looking to farm something, the wiki is filled with all the information you need, and if you need to refresh quests, materials in the maps or bosses, an option is there to regenerate all the island except the one you'll set as "home", so you can infinitely grind on your world, and I advise playing with the map size "Huge", it felt rewarding to find quests, dungeons, and all...

To get all achievements, it took me almost 100 hours. And with the Legendary Edition that comes with everything that the game has to offer, I'd say it's a pretty worthy experience, alone or with friends.
